user.title: Eshtaya Smart Control
user.description: Install Eshtaya Smart Control. No Tuya Cloud information is required here. Open Tuya Control from the dashboard later if you want to activate the optional Tuya module.

abort.already_configured: Eshtaya Smart Control is already configured.

missing_output.title: Multi-way output entity is missing
missing_output.description: The output entity {entity} used by group {group} no longer exists. Open Multi-Way Control and replace the output entity or restore the original entity.

missing_controller.title: Multi-way controller entity is missing
missing_controller.description: The controller entity {entity} used by group {group} no longer exists. Open Multi-Way Control and replace or remove that controller.

output_unresponsive.title: Multi-way output is not confirming commands
output_unresponsive.description: The physical output {entity} in group {group} has repeatedly failed to confirm commands. Check the device/integration connection, then use Sync Now after it is healthy.

smart_group_fault.title: Smart Group synchronization problem
smart_group_fault.description: Smart Group {group} has a synchronization problem: {error}

sync_group.name: Sync group
sync_group.description: Reconcile one multi-way group using the physical output as authority.

group_id.name: Group ID
group_id.description: Internal group ID shown in the management panel and virtual entity attributes.

disable_group.name: Disable group
disable_group.description: Disable synchronization without deleting the group.

set_group_state.name: Set group state
set_group_state.description: Change the physical output and synchronized followers through the transaction engine.

test_group.name: Test group
test_group.description: Return a non-destructive readiness report without switching the physical load.

set_smart_group_state.name: Set Smart Group state
set_smart_group_state.description: Turn all Smart Group members on or off through the protected engine.

run_smart_group.name: Run Action Group
run_smart_group.description: Run every enabled member in a scene, script, or automation Action Group.

not_loaded.message: Eshtaya Multi-Way Control is not loaded.
